# Questory

> Steam-first library and media intelligence: games dashboard, wishlist and cost analytics, friends and multiplayer planning, family insights, smart collections — plus optional Music, Watch, and Read modules.

Questory is source-available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Personal and noncommercial self-hosting is allowed via Docker Compose.

## Site

- [Home](https://questory-labs.github.io/): Product overview, feature highlights, and links to GitHub and self-hosting
- [Screenshots](https://questory-labs.github.io/screenshots/): UI captures across games, music, watch, read, QEngine, and admin
- [Self-hosting guide](https://questory-labs.github.io/self-hosting/): Docker Compose profiles, environment templates, and optional modules

## Repository

- [Questory on GitHub](https://github.com/Questory-Labs/Questory): Source code, issues, and development
- [Self-hosting (canonical)](https://github.com/Questory-Labs/Questory/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md): Full self-hosting documentation in the main repository
- [License](https://github.com/Questory-Labs/Questory/blob/main/LICENSE): PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/Questory-Labs/Questory/blob/main/README.md): Project overview and quick start
- [Testing guide](https://github.com/Questory-Labs/Questory/blob/main/docs/testing.md): Vitest, Playwright, and CI testing conventions
